Auto-answered by the orchestrator clarify-respond workflow.

DECISIONS:
Q1: A

RATIONALE:
Q1: Only A gives the guard what it needs and still delivers the full release gate. The guard builds its grant from just the issue author and the current body (`implement.yml` lines 1653-1657, passing `--issue-meta-file` to `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py --emit-automation-grant`). Comments never count. The parser `extract_files_touched` (lines 110-140) only accepts a line that is exactly `files_touched:` followed by more-indented `- <path>` lines. The body's current one-line prose form therefore reads as `missing`, which is why #6770 was rejected. This issue was re-issued by the unblock judge, so its author is already the pipeline account, and editing the body to add the two-space-indented block from option A is enough. B adds a new issue for no gain. C drops `scripts/release_ci_gate.sh` and all three workflow files, so the security fix for #6532 would not ship. Proceeding without the edit would repeat the #6770 block, and that block cannot be overridden. Until the body is edited and `/reclarify` is posted, implementation stays blocked, and both releases and #6532 stay paused, as the spec requires.
